title: Molly and the Hill That Grew
synopsis: Molly joins the yard visit and notices a growing pile beneath a conveyor. The two puppies work out that stone can travel uphill on a belt while the stockpile grows below.
continuity_state: Before: Jack has seen crushing and size sorting. The yard has separate finished-stone stockpiles for different grades, with conveyors delivering processed material. Molly has not yet visited the yard during this arc. After: Molly has visited the fenced office viewing area with Rex, Gus and Jack, accompanied by Farmer Ruth and Aunt Jo. The friends have seen one finished-stone conveyor build a conical stockpile; Molly and Rex mark its growth against a fixed post. Finished graded crushed stone remains in separate stockpiles ready for adult loading, and Molly returns to the farm with her blue rope toy.
